mapper.select: SELECT * FROM schema_preaudit.material_completeness_result WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY checked_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO schema_preaudit.material_completeness_result (application_id, required_count, submitted_count, completeness_pct, missing_materials) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{requiredCount}, #{submittedCount}, #{completenessPct}, CAST(#{missingMaterials, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: UPDATE schema_preaudit.material_completeness_result SET required_count = #{requiredCount}, submitted_count = #{submittedCount}, completeness_pct = #{completenessPct}, missing_materials = CAST(#{missingMaterials, typeHandler=com.scfs.common.mybatis.JsonListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), checked_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
